evidence_links.description: AMD designs high-performance CPUs and GPUs for the data centre, PC, and embedded markets.
AMD operates in the Semiconductors sector and is headquartered in the United States.
AMD's EPYC server CPU line competes with established data centre CPU offerings in the market.
AMD's Instinct GPU line targets AI training and inference workloads in cloud and enterprise data centres.
Evidence on long-term GPU market share for AMD in AI training workloads remains incomplete.
NVIDIA designs GPUs and accelerated computing platforms for AI, data centre, gaming, and automotive markets.
NVIDIA operates in the Semiconductors sector and is headquartered in the United States.
NVIDIA's CUDA software platform is widely used in AI research and production workloads.
Evidence on whether NVIDIA's data centre GPU market position is durable long-term remains an open research question.
